verdict.rationale: Latham & Watkins offers software tools through LathamDrive, including a document generator and an Automated Convertible Note, so headless automation is a fair question. Nothing in the evidence shows a CLI, API, or CI integration: the probes found no llms.txt and no OpenAPI spec, and the tools appear to be interactive web and mobile resources only.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
